ops.title: Fleet migration: daemonkit state root move to ~/.daemonkit/agents/<label>
ops.description:
daemonkit moves per-daemon state from the non-hidden `~/<label>/` to `~/.daemonkit/agents/<label>/` (new `paths.Agent(label)`; `daemon.go:56`). **Breaking, no migration by decision** — old state is wiped rather than migrated, on every host.

**Ten consumer modules**, spanning four daemonkit versions, all needing a go.mod bump + rebuild + reinstall:

| module | daemonkit |
|---|---|
| cc-pool | v0.21.4 |
| fusekit | v0.21.4 |
| cc-interact | v0.21.4 |
| cc-skills/plugins/codex (codex-ask) | v0.21.4 |
| synckit | v0.21.2 |
| captain-hook | v0.21.2 |
| cc-orchestrate | v0.21.2 |
| cc-present | v0.21.2 |
| cc-review | v0.21.1 |
| cc-patch | v0.21.0 |

Repos on v0.21.0–v0.21.2 will absorb intervening changes too, so this is not a pure version bump for them.

**Hosts:** this machine and `yasyf-forge-studio` (Tailscale `100.113.56.52`, key auth works, carries the same label dirs). 13 non-hidden `~/com.*` dirs and 14 LaunchAgents to unload/wipe/reload.

**Packaging is not uniform.** `ccp` ships via Homebrew formula (`Cellar/cc-pool`); `codex-ask` ships via Homebrew **Cask** (`Caskroom/codex-ask`, from yasyf/homebrew-tap). Reinstalling those means a release, not a local `go build`.

**Hard prerequisite.** cc-pool `4a3881b` notes the trust requirement compiles into `CCPoolStatus.app`, so 0.65.0's runtime refuses the drain: **bootout the agent before installing over it**, or Supersede fails at "land packaged candidate" with ErrUntrusted.

**Watch out for** the existing cc-notes item on cask-installed daemonkit binaries hanging pre-main under kernel provenance tracking (codex-ask, reposync) — the same binaries this migration reinstalls.

Socket-path budget: `sunPathBytes = 104`; the move adds 18 bytes. On `/Users/yasyf` the longest real label (`com.github.yasyf.synckit.serve`, 73b) keeps ~30b headroom, but a long username plus a long reverse-DNS label is the squeeze case.

ops.text: All 10 consumer modules bumped to the daemonkit release carrying paths.Agent, rebuilt, and reinstalled on both hosts
No ~/com.* state directories remain on either host
Every one of the 14 LaunchAgents reloaded and running against the new state root
ccp add provisions an account end to end on both hosts
codex-ask and any other cask-installed consumers reinstalled via a tap release, not a local build
